description: Nodes that the pseudocode treats in a way their pins do not say, by the node id of the node database (the shell id; a variant keeps it). choice: the flow leaves through exactly one flow output and never through none; `form` is how the call is written ('if' for two outputs, 'switch' for any number), `default` 'first' writes the first output as the `default:` of the switch. A native node with a single flow output always leaves through it, and every other native node with several flow outputs (the loops, Execute only by sequence) runs them in turn. graphEnd: the node that ends a filter graph, which has no flow pins and no execution at all. localVariable: a node that creates a variable of its own each time it is placed in a graph. hiddenInputs: input pins (by index) that only matter when they hold something other than the game's default; a renderer leaves them out unless every pin is asked for.
